item.title: 0.9.4b
item.description:
## Vireo 0.9.4b
Vireo 0.9.4b fixes long chats getting slower and slower.
### Long chats stay fast
- **Late in a long chat, replies took minutes.** Each streamed word made the app redraw every message in the chat, so after a few dozen turns the app used a whole core while the model waited. In a 64-turn chat with Inkling 2 Mini, replies that took 8 seconds at the start took 50–250 seconds by turn 40. It was worst with Inkling, whose thinking is streamed too since 0.9.4. - **Now the app draws a streamed reply at most a dozen times a second, and only the messages on screen.** In the same long chat, eight more turns that had not finished one reply in two and a half minutes all finished in three, with the app using about a third of a core instead of all of it. A fresh 64-turn chat stayed at about 4 seconds a turn from start to end.
### Also
- The Statistics window names the engine as Syrinx, with your Mac's chip.
Everything else in [0.9.4](https://github.com/InvurseStudio/Vireo-app/releases/tag/v0.9.4) is unchanged.
### Requirements
A Mac with Apple silicon (M1 or later) and macOS 14 or later. Inkling 2 Mini needs 48 GB of memory or more; its smaller and native 4-bit versions, 32 GB.
